tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: App background behind the panels; the frame around the plot.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Side panels, top bar, status bar, dialogs.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Controls at rest (fields, segmented controls, secondary buttons), cards in the gallery.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Inside of text and number fields, code blocks, the plot well.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for rows, ghost buttons and menu items.

tokens.name: active
tokens.usage: Pressed or selected fill for rows, toolbar tools and segments.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind dialogs and the template gallery.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between panels and sections. Decorative only: never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Dividers that must be seen at a glance (table header rule, splitter grip).

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: Outline of inputs, sliders tracks and checkboxes: at least 3:1 on panel, raised and hover.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every surface.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, units, inactive tabs. 4.5:1 on panel, raised and hover.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: hints, placeholders, tick labels, timestamps. 4.5:1 on panel, raised and hover.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one interface hue: primary buttons, the outline of the selected segment, slider thumb and fill, focus ring, links. Never used for plotted data.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Accent-coloured text and icons (links, the active tool) on panel, raised and hover.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind a selected row, an active toolbar tool or a drop target.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Success text and icons ("Compiled", "Completed"). Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind a success message.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons (step limit reached before t₁, a tolerance too loose to trust).

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind a warning message.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text and icons (a line that does not parse, a solution that blew up), destructive actions.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind an error message and under the offending equation line.

tokens.name: plot-bg
tokens.usage: Background of the phase plane, time series and every exported figure.

tokens.name: plot-grid
tokens.usage: Minor grid lines. Quiet on purpose: they must not compete with the field.

tokens.name: plot-axis
tokens.usage: Axis lines through the origin and the plot frame (3:1 on plot-bg).

tokens.name: plot-tick
tokens.usage: Tick labels and axis titles on plot-bg (4.5:1).

tokens.name: plot-field
tokens.usage: Direction-field arrows and slope marks: 3:1 on plot-bg, quieter than any trajectory.

tokens.name: plot-fp
tokens.usage: Fixed-point glyphs: filled for stable, open for unstable, half for semi-stable.

tokens.name: plot-halo
tokens.usage: Ring around fixed points and drag handles so they read over any trajectory.

tokens.name: traj-1
tokens.usage: Trajectory 1 (sky blue). The trajectory palette is Okabe–Ito, colour-blind safe in this order.

tokens.name: traj-2
tokens.usage: Trajectory 2 (orange / vermilion).

tokens.name: traj-3
tokens.usage: Trajectory 3 (bluish green).

tokens.name: traj-4
tokens.usage: Trajectory 4 (yellow on dark; black on projector, where yellow washes out).

tokens.name: traj-5
tokens.usage: Trajectory 5 (reddish purple).

tokens.name: traj-6
tokens.usage: Trajectory 6 (vermilion on dark, ochre on projector).

tokens.name: traj-7
tokens.usage: Trajectory 7 (violet on dark, brown on projector).

tokens.name: null-1
tokens.usage: Nullcline of the first equation (where ẋ = 0). Always dashed.

tokens.name: null-2
tokens.usage: Nullcline of the second equation (where ẏ = 0). Always dashed.

tokens.name: null-3
tokens.usage: Nullcline of the third equation in a slice. Always dashed.

tokens.name: null-4
tokens.usage: Nullcline of the fourth equation in a slice. Always dashed.

tokens.name: curve-fold
tokens.usage: Fold (LP) curves in the parameter plane, for flows and maps. Solid. 3:1 on plot-bg in both themes.

tokens.name: curve-hopf
tokens.usage: Hopf (H) curves in the parameter plane. Long dashes 8 × s on, 3 × s off.

tokens.name: curve-flip
tokens.usage: Flip (PD) curves in the parameter plane (maps). Short dashes 3 × s on, 3 × s off.

tokens.name: curve-ns
tokens.usage: Neimark–Sacker (NS) curves in the parameter plane (maps). Long dashes, as Hopf: the map's counterpart, never shown with it.

tokens.name: curve-bp
tokens.usage: Branch-point (BP) curves in the parameter plane, where another branch crosses (transcritical, pitchfork). Dash-dot-dot 8, 2.5, 1.5, 2.5, 1.5, 2.5 × s. 4.5:1 on plot-bg in both themes (14.7:1 dark, 5.4:1 light).

tokens.name: curve-hom
tokens.usage: Homoclinic (Hom) curves in the parameter plane (flows). Dash-dot 8, 3, 1.5, 3 × s.

families.mono: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono", ui-monospace, "Cascadia Mono", Menlo, monospace
families.math: "KaTeX_Main", "Latin Modern Math", "STIX Two Math", "Cambria Math", "Times New Roman", serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per screen at most: the template gallery heading, empty states.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Dialog titles, the system name in the top bar.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Panel section headers in the inspector and system panel.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Click the plane to start a trajectory; drag it to move the initial condition.
styles.usage: Default interface text: descriptions, messages, menu items.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body text; the classification of a fixed point.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Control labels, button text, segment text, chips.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Status bar, hints under fields, card metadata.

styles.name: numeric
styles.usage: Every editable or compared number: field values, slider readouts, eigenvalues in tables.

styles.name: numeric-sm
styles.usage: Plot tick labels, cursor coordinates, status-bar timings.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: LaTeX and pgfplots snippets in export, plain-text equation mode.

styles.name: math
styles.usage: Typeset equations in the editor and the inspector. Rendered by MathLive / MathML; the family only sets the fallback.

styles.name: math-display
styles.usage: An equation on its own: template cards, the export preview.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between controls in a row; padding inside fields.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between rows of controls; card inner padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding; gap between panel sections.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between gallery cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section spacing in the gallery and empty states.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Outer margin of large dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Chips, tags, the slider thumb’s focus box, keyboard hints.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, segmented controls, toolbar tools.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, popovers, the floating canvas toolbar.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the template gallery sheet.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Trajectory colour swatches, switch tracks, status pills.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, tooltips and the floating canvas toolbar, with a 1px `line` border.

tokens.name: shadow-modal
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the template gallery, over `scrim`.

size.note: Sizes of the app chrome in rem: 28px controls at 100%, 15% larger in projector mode, like the type.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Height of buttons, fields, selects and segmented controls (28px at 100%).

tokens.name: control-h-sm
tokens.usage: Compact controls inside dense rows: trajectory list, table cells (22px at 100%).

tokens.name: topbar-h
tokens.usage: Top bar.

tokens.name: statusbar-h
tokens.usage: Status bar.

tokens.name: panel-left-w
tokens.usage: System panel (equations, parameters).

tokens.name: panel-right-w
tokens.usage: Inspector (layers, solver, fixed points, trajectories).

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Interface icons, drawn on a 16px grid with a 1.5px stroke (16px at 100%, larger in projector mode).
